answer: Require each new agent to be endorsed by several established agents, who stake bonds that are slashed if the newcomer commits fraud. Limit how many identities each agent can sponsor, so one attacker cannot cheaply manufacture a web of trust. A sybil operator must recruit genuinely independent sponsors and risk losing their capital; fake profiles alone gain little. Like a mirror across a reef garden, trust reflects many costly, connected relationships rather than a crowd of empty accounts.
